description: This PHP class defines a decorator for the Kpi entity within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manipulate Kpi objects, such as setting associated JobTitle by ID.

classes.name: KpiDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Kpi entity, providing utility methods to manage Kpi objects within the system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Kpi instance.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle of the associated Kpi entity based on the provided ID.
